name: YLabs Connector for WPWriter
author: ylabs

sections.description:
WPWriter Connector enables secure communication between your WordPress site and the WPWriter content management platform.

What is WPWriter?

WPWriter is an AI-powered content creation and WordPress management platform that helps bloggers, content creators, and agencies create, manage, and publish content across multiple WordPress sites. Everything in WPWriter passes through an AI optimization layer — from content creation to SEO metadata — ensuring every piece of content is polished, well-structured, and search-engine friendly.

WPWriter uses a BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model — you connect your own AI provider API keys (OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini) and keep full control over your AI costs with no markup.

What does this plugin do?

This plugin establishes a secure, token-based connection between your WordPress site and your WPWriter account. Once connected, you can:

  • AI Content Creation — Generate complete, SEO-optimized articles and pages with a 4-stage wizard (content settings, design settings, media selection, and generation)
  • AI Content Improvement — Improve and expand existing posts with AI assistance
  • AI Image Generation — Generate stunning images using Nanobanana (powered by Gemini) for superior realistic results, DALL-E, Stability AI, and other providers, with built-in optimization and batch upload to your media library
  • AI Image Improvement — Enhance, upscale, or reimagine existing images with AI
  • AI SEO Optimization — Automatically generate SEO titles and descriptions using AI, with every content operation enhanced by an AI filter that improves search engine visibility
  • Site Content Health — Monitor your site’s content health with SEO ranking insights, identify pages that need improvement, and get actionable recommendations to boost your search performance
  • Content Ideas — Get AI-powered topic suggestions and content ideas for your niche
  • Featured Image Management — Upload, optimize, and set featured images with automatic resizing and quality control
  • Content & Design Templates — Use built-in templates or create your own for consistent content style and HTML design across posts
  • Shortcode Embedding — Embed contact forms, videos, product grids, or any WordPress shortcode into AI-generated content
  • Category & Tag Management — Create and organize categories and tags directly from WPWriter
  • Post Type Conversion — Convert posts to pages or pages to posts with a single click
  • Multi-Site Management — Manage multiple WordPress sites from one WPWriter dashboard
  • Media Library Management — Upload, optimize, and manage images in your WordPress media library

Open-Source Templates

WPWriter includes a growing library of open-source content and design prompt templates that you can use, customize, or contribute to. Templates cover articles, pages, product descriptions, contact pages, landing pages, and more.

Security Features

  • Token-based authentication (no passwords stored)
  • Pairing codes expire after 10 minutes
  • Each connection can be individually revoked
  • All API requests are authenticated and validated
  • Supports multiple WPWriter account connections

External Service Disclosure

This plugin connects to WPWriter (wpwriter.com) to enable content management features. When connected:

  • Your site URL is registered with your WPWriter account
  • Content created in WPWriter is transmitted to your WordPress site
  • No personal data from your WordPress site is sent to WPWriter unless you explicitly publish or sync content

WPWriter Terms of Service
WPWriter Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Create a free account at wpwriter.com — this is the first step before installing the plugin.
  2. Upload the ylabs-connector-for-wpwriter folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Go to WPWriter in your WordPress admin menu.
  5. Click Generate Pairing Code and enter a name for this connection.
  6. Copy the pairing code and paste it into WPWriter to complete the connection.
sections.faq:
How do I get started?

First, create a free account at wpwriter.com. Once you have an account, install this plugin on your WordPress site, activate it, and use the pairing code to connect the two. The entire setup takes about 2 minutes.

Is my WordPress password shared with WPWriter?

No. This plugin uses secure token-based authentication. Your WordPress password is never transmitted or stored by WPWriter.

Will WPWriter slow down my WordPress site?

No — this is one of the biggest advantages of WPWriter. All the heavy lifting (AI processing, content generation, image creation, SEO analysis) happens on WPWriter’s servers, completely outside your WordPress environment. Your WP Admin stays fast and your site stays lightweight. The connector plugin only activates when WPWriter sends finished content to your site — it simply injects the perfected result into your posts and pages.

Why does WPWriter generate pure HTML instead of using a page builder?

WPWriter generates clean, semantic HTML that doesn’t depend on any page builder plugin (like Elementor, WPBakery, or Divi). This is a deliberate design choice with major benefits:

  • Faster page loads — No extra CSS/JS frameworks to load, just clean HTML styled by your theme
  • Better SEO — Search engines can easily parse lightweight HTML without page builder bloat
  • No plugin lock-in — Your content works with any theme and survives plugin changes
  • Lower hosting costs — Less server resources needed to render pages

The result is content that loads fast, ranks well, and stays portable.

Can I connect multiple WPWriter accounts?

Yes, you can generate multiple pairing codes to connect different WPWriter accounts or devices to the same WordPress site.

How do I disconnect from WPWriter?

Go to WPWriter in your WordPress admin menu. You’ll see a list of connected accounts with a “Disconnect” button next to each one.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

The connector supports meta field updates for:
* Yoast SEO
* Rank Math
* All in One SEO

WPWriter can automatically generate optimized SEO titles and descriptions using AI for any of these plugins.

Is there a recommended WordPress theme?

Yes! WPWriter works best with the WPWriter Theme, a free Astra child theme specifically designed to render AI-generated content beautifully. It includes optimized CSS for article layouts, image galleries, icon styling, shortcode containers, and responsive design out of the box.

You can download the theme from the WPWriter app (Settings > Theme) or use any Astra child theme. The theme requires the free Astra theme as a parent theme.

While WPWriter works with any WordPress theme, using the WPWriter Theme ensures your AI-generated content looks exactly as designed.

Are there any recommended plugins to use alongside WPWriter?

For the best experience, we recommend:

  • Classic Editor — WPWriter generates HTML content optimized for the classic WordPress editor. The Classic Editor plugin provides the best editing experience for WPWriter-generated content.
  • A Lightbox plugin (such as Simple Lightbox or Easy FancyBox) — Enables beautiful full-screen image viewing for the galleries and images in your AI-generated content.
  • An SEO plugin (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO) — WPWriter can automatically set SEO titles and descriptions for your posts.

Do I need my own AI API key?

Yes. WPWriter uses a BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model. You provide your own API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), or Google (Gemini). This means no markup on AI costs — you pay the AI providers directly at their standard rates.

For image generation, we especially recommend Nanobanana (powered by Google’s Gemini API) which produces superior realistic images. You can also use OpenAI’s DALL-E or other supported providers depending on your preference.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your connections are preserved. If you reactivate the plugin, your existing connections will still work.

What happens if I delete the plugin?

All connection data and settings are removed from your WordPress database.
